seo.title: AI agent platform with governance | Humanika
seo.description: Humanika Core lets you build, connect and supervise AI agents with your documents, systems and channels, with roles, audit trails and human review.

hero.title: The platform to build, run and supervise AI agents
hero.description: Humanika Core is the platform we use to configure each organization's digital collaborators. We connect them to your documents, systems and channels, and run them with permissions, traceability and human review.

capabilities.title: Everything needed to put an agent to work
capabilities.description: From initial setup to day-to-day monitoring, in one place.

items.title: Configurable digital collaborators
items.text: A guided assistant defines the agent's identity, knowledge, AI model, channels and the legal documents each user accepts.

items.title: Connected knowledge
items.text: The agent learns from PDF, Word and PowerPoint files, websites and folders synced from Google Drive, SharePoint and OneDrive.

items.title: Specialized agents working together
items.text: An orchestrator coordinates knowledge, analysis, document and evaluation agents to solve each request step by step.

items.title: Conversations with human handoff
items.text: Every conversation is logged and can go to an operator when a query needs a person's attention.

items.title: Supervision and metrics
items.text: A dashboard shows conversations by channel, resolved and escalated cases, each agent's performance and model usage and cost.

items.title: Documents and deliverables
items.text: Agents produce Word, PDF and Excel documents from templates, ready for your team's review.

connections.title: Channels, systems and AI models
connections.description: Humanika integrates with the tools your organization already uses. Available integrations are confirmed for each project.

governance.title: AI with clear rules and people in charge
governance.description: Every agent action follows defined permissions and leaves a trail for review.

items.title: Roles and permissions
items.text: Built-in and custom roles define who configures, operates, supervises or only views, platform-wide or per client.

items.title: Audit and traceability
items.text: The platform logs operations, message deliveries and errors, so you can review what happened and when.

items.title: Human review
items.text: People approve assessments, review deliverables and see which parts the AI completed and with what evidence.

items.title: Access and consent
items.text: Access is controlled with email codes, Google or Microsoft sign-in, allowed domains or invitations, and each user accepts the terms.

languages.title: Service in several languages
languages.description: Each agent is configured in the language of the people it serves.

cta.title: See the platform working on a case from your organization
cta.description: Tell us which process you want to improve and we'll show you how an agent would be configured to handle it.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to learn about the Humanika platform and request a demo.
